item.title: Entrepreneurship: Shaping the Future
item.content:encoded:
Diego Matricano, }],

This multi-journal collection brings together research on entrepreneurship as a mechanism for addressing major global challenges. The collection welcomes cross-disciplinary contributions from researchers, practitioners, and policymakers examining how entrepreneurial activities generate expected and realized changes across different contexts and their implications.

Papers in the collection investigate entrepreneurship's impact on shaping the future by analyzing phenomena at micro, meso, and macro levels of analysis. Submissions are welcomed across three participating journals with varying disciplinary focuses: international entrepreneurship contexts, entrepreneurship in diverse organizational settings, and global entrepreneurship phenomena.

Appel publié par International Entrepreneurship and Management Journal. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Entrepreneurship and global issues
  • Entrepreneurship at micro, meso, and macro levels
  • Impact of entrepreneurship on future outcomes
